text: The new encoder parameter for django.utils.html.json_script function allows customizing a JSON encoder class.
suggestion_reason: json_script gains a callable encoder parameter; check code that passes or wraps it.

text: The minimum supported version of mysqlclient is increased from 1.4.0 to 1.4.3.
suggestion_reason: The mysqlclient minimum version is an installed dependency requirement.

text: The new "server_side_binding" option is now supported in OPTIONS on PostgreSQL with psycopg 3.1.8+ to allow using server-side binding cursors.
suggestion_reason: The PostgreSQL server_side_binding option belongs in database connection configuration.

text: The default iteration count for the PBKDF2 password hasher is increased from 390,000 to 600,000.
suggestion_reason: The changed hasher work factor affects runtime cost and password-hasher configuration.

text: MySQL 8+ allows functional dependencies on GROUP BY columns, so the pre-Django 4.2 workaround of grouping by primary keys of the main table is removed. As a consequence, using RawSQL() aggregations is no longer supported on MySQL as there is no way to determine if such aggregations are needed or valid in the GROUP BY clause. Use aggregation-functions instead.
suggestion_reason: Code using RawSQL aggregations on MySQL must change because that use is unsupported.

text: The admin/delete_confirmation.html template now has some additional blocks and scripting hooks to ease customization.
suggestion_reason: The admin confirmation template gains blocks and hooks that affect template customization.

text: django.contrib.postgres.fields.CIEmailField is deprecated in favor of EmailField(db_collation="…") with a case-insensitive non-deterministic collation.
suggestion_reason: The replacement names both a Python model field and a database collation; code and schema checks are both plausible first steps.

text: The default scheme for forms.URLField will change from "http" to "https" in Django 6.0. Set FORMS_URLFIELD_ASSUME_HTTPS transitional setting to True to opt into assuming "https" during the Django 5.x release cycle.
suggestion_reason: The note explicitly calls for a transitional FORMS_URLFIELD_ASSUME_HTTPS setting.

text: The AlreadyRegistered and NotRegistered exceptions are moved from django.contrib.admin.sites to django.contrib.admin.exceptions.
suggestion_reason: Imports of the moved exception classes must use their new module.

text: The default value of the USE_TZ setting is changed from False to True.
suggestion_reason: The default value of a Django setting changes; check the application's setting.

text: The new AdminSite.get_log_entries method allows customizing the queryset for the site's listed log entries.
suggestion_reason: An AdminSite method is added for code that customizes the log-entry queryset.

text: The new ExclusionConstraint.violation_error_code attribute of django.contrib.postgres.constraints.ExclusionConstraint allows customizing the code of ValidationError raised during model validation.
suggestion_reason: ExclusionConstraint gains a Python attribute controlling a ValidationError code.

text: The new ClosestPoint() function returns a 2-dimensional point on the geometry that is closest to another geometry.
suggestion_reason: The new ClosestPoint function is a callable interface used in GIS code.

text: django.test.Client and django.test.AsyncClient now provide asynchronous methods, using an a prefix: django.test.Client.asession, django.test.Client.alogin, django.test.Client.aforce_login, and django.test.Client.alogout.
suggestion_reason: Test Client and AsyncClient gain named async methods for code to call.

text: The new from_queryset argument of Model.refresh_from_db and Model.arefresh_from_db allows customizing the queryset used to reload a model's value. This can be used to lock the row before reloading or to select related objects.
suggestion_reason: refresh_from_db gains a named argument that application code can use.

text: django.contrib.gis.db.models.Collect is now supported on MySQL 8.0.24+.
suggestion_reason: Collect support depends on the deployed MySQL version, 8.0.24 or later.

text: Django 5.1 also introduces connection pool support for PostgreSQL. As the time to establish a new connection can be relatively long, keeping connections open can reduce latency.
suggestion_reason: PostgreSQL connection pooling is a database connection setup choice.

text: django.db.models.FileField now raises a django.core.exceptions.FieldError when saving a file without a name.
suggestion_reason: Saving a nameless FileField now raises FieldError; caller exception handling may change.

text: The django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2.coords() method is deprecated. Use django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2.lon_lat() instead.
suggestion_reason: Callers of the deprecated GeoIP2.coords method should use lon_lat.

text: Django 5.1 introduces the {% querystring %} template tag, simplifying the modification of query parameters in URLs, making it easier to generate links that maintain existing query parameters while adding or changing specific ones.
suggestion_reason: The querystring template tag changes the URLs rendered in page links.

text: The model django.contrib.postgres.fields.CICharField, django.contrib.postgres.fields.CIEmailField, and django.contrib.postgres.fields.CITextField are removed, except for support in historical migrations.
suggestion_reason: The removed CI model field classes require code references to change; historical migrations remain supported.

text: The ordering keyword argument of the PostgreSQL specific aggregation functions django.contrib.postgres.aggregates.ArrayAgg, django.contrib.postgres.aggregates.JSONBAgg, and django.contrib.postgres.aggregates.StringAgg is deprecated in favor of the order_by argument.
suggestion_reason: Calls using the deprecated ordering keyword should switch to order_by.

text: Django 5.2 supports Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14 (as of 5.2.8). We highly recommend and only officially support the latest release of each series.
suggestion_reason: The note states which Python runtimes are supported for deployment.

text: The new asset object django.forms.Script is available for adding custom HTML-attributes to JavaScript in form media. See paths as objects for more details.
suggestion_reason: The new django.forms.Script object is a Python interface for form media customization.

text: The attribute SafeExceptionReporterFilter.hidden_settings now treats values as sensitive if their name includes AUTH.
suggestion_reason: Error-report output now hides more setting values as sensitive.

text: The SELECT clause generated when using QuerySet.values and QuerySet.values_list now matches the specified order of the referenced expressions. Previously, the order was based on a set of counterintuitive rules which made query combination through methods such as QuerySet.union unpredictable.
suggestion_reason: The generated SELECT and combined queryset behavior change ORM data results.

text: MySQL connections now default to using the utf8mb4 character set, instead of utf8, which is an alias for the deprecated character set utf8mb3.
suggestion_reason: The default MySQL connection character set changes; check database connection setup.

text: Tuple items of EmailMessage.attachments and EmailMultiAlternatives.attachments are now named tuples, as opposed to regular tuples.
suggestion_reason: Attachment tuple objects change shape to named tuples, affecting consuming code.

text: Migrations now support serialization of zoneinfo.ZoneInfo instances.
suggestion_reason: Serialization of ZoneInfo instances is a migration-data behavior.

text: The new variable forloop.length is now available within a for loop.
suggestion_reason: The new template loop variable changes what a rendered template can show.

text: Widgets from django.contrib.gis.forms.widgets now render without inline JavaScript in templates. If you have customized any geometry widgets or their templates, you may need to update them to match the new layout.
suggestion_reason: GIS widgets render with a new template layout and no inline JavaScript.

text: The undocumented django.utils.itercompat.is_iterable() function and the django.utils.itercompat module are removed.
suggestion_reason: The removed module and function require import or call sites to change.

text: Added support and translations for the Haitian Creole language.
suggestion_reason: New translations affect the language visible in the interface.

text: Setting ADMINS or MANAGERS to a list of (name, address) tuples is deprecated. Set to a list of email address strings instead. Django never used the name portion. To include a name, format the address string as '"Name" <address>' or use Python's email.utils.formataddr.
suggestion_reason: ADMINS and MANAGERS must use a new settings value format.

text: Common utilities, such as django.conf.settings, are now automatically imported to the shell by default.
suggestion_reason: The shell command now shows common utilities already imported in its interactive namespace.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 where querystring mishandled multi-value django.http.QueryDict keys, both by only preserving the last value and by incorrectly handling None values (36783).
suggestion_reason: The querystring tag now preserves multi-value query parameters in generated URLs.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused fields to be incorrectly selected when using QuerySet.alias() after values() (36299).
suggestion_reason: The fix changes fields selected by an ORM query using alias after values.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using OuterRef in PostgreSQL aggregate functions ArrayAgg, StringAgg, and JSONBAgg (36405).
suggestion_reason: The fix concerns an ORM aggregate query with OuterRef.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that reduced the color contrast of the chosen label of filter_horizontal and filter_vertical widgets within a TabularInline (36601).
suggestion_reason: The fix restores the visible color contrast of admin widgets.

text: Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when using a ManyToManyField on a model with a composite primary key, by extending the fields.E347 system check (36530).
suggestion_reason: A ManyToManyField with a composite primary key is a model data relationship check.

text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where proxy models having a CompositePrimaryKey incorrectly raised a models.E042 system check error.
suggestion_reason: The system check concerns proxy models with composite primary keys.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.2 where HttpRequest.get_preferred_type() incorrectly preferred more specific media types with a lower quality (36447).
suggestion_reason: The selected media type can change the HTTP response behavior seen by a client.

text: Reverted an undocumented optimization in Django 6.0 that modified permission django.contrib.auth.models.Permission.name and django.contrib.auth.models.Permission.codename values when renaming models via a migration. This change could affect unrelated django.contrib.auth.models.Permission objects (36843) and did not report conflicts (36793).
suggestion_reason: The migration changed persisted Permission names and codenames, including unrelated objects.

text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where subqueries using "pk" to reference models with a CompositePrimaryKey failed to raise ValueError when too many or too few columns were selected (36392).
suggestion_reason: The affected subquery now raises ValueError for an invalid column count.

text: django.utils.html.strip_tags would be slow to evaluate certain inputs containing large sequences of incomplete HTML tags. This function is used to implement the striptags template filter, which was thus also vulnerable.
suggestion_reason: The note explicitly names both the strip_tags function and striptags template filter; code and template checks are both plausible.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 where the Widget.use_fieldset attribute of django.forms.ClearableFileInput was flipped from False to True (36829).
suggestion_reason: The widget's fieldset setting affects the rendered file input form.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 that prevented changing the name of a django.db.models.ManyToManyField from taking effect when applying migrations (36800).
suggestion_reason: Renaming a ManyToManyField now takes effect when applying migrations.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when no arguments were passed into QuerySet.union() (36388).
suggestion_reason: QuerySet.union with no arguments previously crashed; check such method calls.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 where subclasses of RemoteUserMiddleware that had overridden process_request() were no longer supported (36390).
suggestion_reason: RemoteUserMiddleware subclasses that override process_request are the affected code interface.

text: Fixed a crash in Django 6.0 caused by infinite recursion when calling repr() on an unevaluated django.utils.csp.LazyNonce instance (36810).
suggestion_reason: Calling repr on a LazyNonce object is the affected Python interface.
